mapper.select: select message_id, date_, contenu, cip, discussion_id from app.message where (discussion_id, cip, message_id) = (coalesce(#{discussionId}, discussion_id), coalesce(#{cip}, cip), coalesce(#{messageId}, message_id)) order by date_ ASC limit #{limite} offset #{decalage}
select message_id, date_, contenu, cip, discussion_id from app.message where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: insert into app.message(message_id, date_, contenu, cip, discussion_id) values (#{message.id}, #{message.date}, #{message.contenu}, #{message.cip}, #{message.discussionId}) on conflict (message_id) do update set contenu = excluded.contenu;
mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id, m.date_, m.contenu, m.cip, m.discussion_id FROM app.message m JOIN app.discussion disc ON m.discussion_id = disc.discussion_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.equipe e WHERE e.discussion_id = disc.discussion_id ) AND m.discussion_id IN (SELECT fp.discussion_id FROM app.fait_parti fp GROUP BY fp.discussion_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fp.cip) = 2 AND BOOL_AND(fp.cip IN (#{cip1}, #{cip2}))) ORDER BY date_ ASC LIMIT #{limite} OFFSET #{decalage}
